crew_plan.notes: Planning-only reference data. Validation checks its contract; it does not dispatch this plan.

brief.objective: Map the supplied project constraints into a concise planning note.
brief.output_contract: A planning note with sections [Constraints, Assumptions, Open questions].
brief.tools_sources_constraints: Use only material supplied with the task and label assumptions; this reference does not select or invoke a provider.
brief.not_responsible_for: Executing work, choosing a provider, approving a change, or making an external claim.
brief.escalation_trigger: Missing or contradictory constraints require the task to stop and surface the gap to the conductor.

tasks.flag_for_tess: Use an available contributor only after the conductor has supplied its own host-specific dispatch controls.

escalations: If the planning note exposes an irreversible, external, or production-facing decision, stop and create a separately verified task.
